name: Tiotoriva
subtitle: Tiotropium 18 µg DPI inhalation capsules
summary: The gold-standard therapy and first-line treatment for COPD; the first mass-produced dry powder inhalation product in Iran, built on domestic know-how.

meta.label: Dosage form
meta.value: DPI inhalation capsule containing 18 micrograms of tiotropium

sections.title: COPD — chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
sections.body: COPD is a group of progressive respiratory diseases; it is the most common cause of death and disability from lung disease and the fourth life-threatening disease worldwide. Difficulty breathing, intermittent coughing, shortness of breath, wheezing and increased sputum are common symptoms. Prolonged exposure to tobacco smoke and air pollution can cause or aggravate this disease.

sections.title: Mechanism of action
sections.body: Tiotropium is a long-acting antimuscarinic agent (LAMA) that dilates the bronchi by blocking M3 receptors of the smooth muscles.

sections.title: Particular features of Tiotoriva
items: Gold-standard therapy and first-line treatment for COPD compared with other drugs in this class
Silica gel inside the canister prevents moisture reaching the capsules
Moisture-resistant capsule shells; suitable for use in humid regions
The lowest excipient volume in the formulation compared with the reference brand

sections.title: Dosage and administration
sections.body: For oral inhalation only. The contents of one capsule (18 micrograms) once daily, at the same time each day, using the Capsulizer device.

sections.title: Contraindications
items: Hypersensitivity to atropine and its derivatives, ipratropium or any component of the formulation
Make sure you are alert before driving or operating machinery (possible blurred vision)
Not recommended in children under six years

sections.title: Drug interactions
sections.body: With other anticholinergics such as atropine and ipratropium.

sections.title: Side effects
sections.body: Dry mouth, constipation or dizziness may occur. If they persist or worsen, inform your physician.

sections.title: Pregnancy and lactation
sections.body: Category C in pregnancy. Information on secretion into breast milk is limited; use with caution during lactation.

sections.title: Storage
sections.body: Room temperature, away from light and moisture.

sections.title: Pack contents
sections.body: Each canister contains 30 tiotropium bromide inhalation capsules.

motion.title: Tiotropium in the airway
motion.lead: A bronchus in cross-section: the smooth muscle around the airway contracts through M3 receptors.

states.label: Untreated
states.caption: Acetylcholine binds the M3 receptors of the smooth muscle; the muscle contracts and the airway narrows.

states.label: Tiotropium
states.caption: Tiotropium takes the place of acetylcholine on the M3 receptors and stays there for a long time.

states.label: Open airway
states.caption: The muscle relaxes, the airway widens and air flows more easily — with one dose a day.

name: Coldanese Plus
subtitle: Carrageenan and xylitol nasal spray
summary: A nasal spray with over 90% effectiveness against cold and influenza viruses; moisturises the respiratory tract and is suitable for all ages.

meta.label: Dosage form
meta.value: Nasal spray containing 1.2 mg carrageenan and 50 mg xylitol per millilitre

sections.title: Why Coldanese Plus?
sections.body: Coldanese Plus is used to moisturise the respiratory tract and to prevent and treat viral infections. The spray eliminates more than 90 percent of the viruses that cause colds and influenza and shortens the duration of a cold. Its formulation forms a protective physical film over the nasal mucosa.

sections.title: Composition
sections.body: Contains carrageenan (a natural substance derived from red seaweed) and xylitol. Iota-carrageenan has antiviral activity against colds, influenza, rhinovirus, herpes simplex and coronavirus.

sections.title: Features and uses
items: Creates and maintains moisture of the nasal mucosa
Eliminates respiratory viruses such as influenza, the common cold and coronavirus
Relieves cold symptoms (runny and blocked nose)
Shortens the duration of a cold
Improves breathing quality and increases respiratory airflow
Removes allergens and pollutants from the nasal mucosa
Thins and softens nasal secretions
Relieves dryness of the nasal mucosa
Reduces nasal swelling
Suitable for all ages

sections.title: Use in children
sections.body: Coldanese Plus cleanses and cares for the nose in rhinitis, dryness or mucosal irritation. With a few daily sprays, a blocked nose is cleaned and washed. Suitable for all age groups, especially children over one year.

sections.title: Directions for use
sections.body: For moisturising and prevention: three times daily, one spray into each nostril. At the onset of symptoms the frequency may be increased. Hold the bottle upright. For infants, keep the head steady and insert the nozzle carefully.

sections.title: Warnings
sections.body: Long-term use is safe. For people over one year of age. Each bottle should be used by one person only.

sections.title: Drug interactions
sections.body: No specific drug interactions have been reported.

sections.title: Pregnancy and lactation
sections.body: Safe and usable during pregnancy and lactation.

sections.title: Packaging
sections.body: Each bottle contains 20 ml of clear, colourless solution (about 200 sprays).

sections.title: Storage
sections.body: Below 30 degrees Celsius, away from light and freezing. Clean the nozzle after each use.

motion.title: A carrageenan shield on the nasal lining
motion.lead: The nasal mucosa up close: cells, cilia and the viruses that arrive with the air.

states.label: Unprotected
states.caption: Viruses reach the surface of the nasal cells and attach to them.

states.label: Spray
states.caption: Carrageenan strands form a physical protective layer over the mucosa, and xylitol keeps it moist.

states.label: Trapped
states.caption: Viruses are caught in the carrageenan mesh and cleared from the nose by cilia and secretions.

name: Folinozit
subtitle: Oral powder of myo-inositol and folic acid
summary: A supplement effective in improving polycystic ovary syndrome, insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes; supplies myo-inositol and folic acid.

meta.label: Dosage form
meta.value: 2 g sachet (2000 mg myo-inositol and 0.2 mg folic acid)

sections.title: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
sections.body: PCOS is a common condition affecting the function of the ovaries in women, seen in 5 to 10 percent of women. Irregular periods, fertility problems, hirsutism, acne and weight gain are common symptoms.

sections.title: Composition of the Folinozit sachet
sections.body: Myo-inositol is a natural substance in every living cell, essential for the correct function of insulin. Many women with PCOS have a genetic deficiency of myo-inositol. Folic acid also reduces the occurrence of neural tube defects in newborns.

sections.title: Indications
sections.body: Supplying myo-inositol and folic acid. A dietary supplement in the treatment of PCOS, insulin resistance (pre-diabetes) and type 2 diabetes. An adjuvant in controlling ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome.

sections.title: Dosage and administration
sections.body: Twice daily, one sachet dissolved in a glass of water (about 100 ml); on an empty stomach, 30 minutes before a meal.

sections.title: If a dose is missed
sections.body: Taking two sachets at the same time is not harmful, but it is better to take them about 12 hours apart. Larger doses do not make up for missed ones.

sections.title: Contraindications
sections.body: In case of hypersensitivity to the contents. This product is a food supplement and is not intended for diagnosis, prevention or treatment.

sections.title: Drug interactions
sections.body: There is no evidence of negative interactions; however, consult a physician or pharmacist.

sections.title: Side effects
sections.body: At doses of 12 g per day or more: nausea, bloating, sleep problems, headache, dizziness and fatigue.

sections.title: Pregnancy and lactation
sections.body: Use as advised by a physician.

sections.title: Storage
sections.body: Dry, cool place, away from direct sunlight.

sections.title: Pack contents
sections.body: Each box contains 30 sachets.

motion.title: Myo-inositol and the insulin signal
motion.lead: A cell membrane: insulin sends a signal, and glucose transporters must come to the surface.

states.label: Insulin resistance
states.caption: Insulin binds its receptor, but the signal inside the cell is weak; glucose stays outside.

states.label: Myo-inositol
states.caption: Myo-inositol, the building block of insulin’s intracellular messengers, completes the signal path.

states.label: Glucose enters
states.caption: Glucose transporters (GLUT4) move to the membrane and glucose enters the cell.

name: Meglozek
subtitle: Esomeprazole 10 enteric-coated granules
summary: A proton pump inhibitor for preparing an oral suspension; suitable for reflux and especially for infants and children.

meta.label: Therapeutic class
meta.value: Gastrointestinal drugs inhibiting gastric acid secretion and anti-ulcer

meta.label: Dosage form
meta.value: 1 g sachet containing 10 mg enteric-coated esomeprazole granules

sections.title: Acid reflux
sections.body: The return of stomach acid from the stomach into the oesophagus (GERD) is called acid reflux. This process can damage the surface tissue of the oesophagus.

sections.title: Reflux in infants
sections.body: In infants under 6 months, the muscular ring between the oesophagus and stomach is not yet fully developed. About half of children experience reflux by their first birthday.

sections.title: Dosage and administration
sections.body: Empty the sachet into 5 ml of water and stir. After 2 to 3 minutes it thickens; stir again and drink within 30 minutes. Do not take the medicine dry, do not chew the granules, and preferably take one hour before a meal.

sections.title: Mechanism of action
sections.body: It is a proton pump inhibitor; by inhibiting gastric acid secretion it prevents acid returning to the oesophagus.

sections.title: A particular feature of Meglozek
sections.body: Formulated with the fewest excipients and a final weight of one gram; the granules disperse well in water so the full dose reaches the patient.

sections.title: Contraindications
sections.body: In case of hypersensitivity to esomeprazole or similar drugs (lansoprazole, omeprazole, pantoprazole, rabeprazole). In severe osteoporosis or chronic liver and kidney disease, consult a physician.

sections.title: Drug interactions
sections.body: As with esomeprazole interactions.

sections.title: Side effects
sections.body: Headache, diarrhoea, nausea, bloating, abdominal pain, dry mouth and constipation (adults), drowsiness (children) and rapid breathing (infants).

sections.title: Precautions
sections.body: Heartburn is sometimes mistaken for the signs of a heart attack. With chest pain, nausea or pain spreading to the arm, see a physician.

sections.title: Pregnancy and lactation
sections.body: Category B; probably secreted in breast milk.

sections.title: Storage
sections.body: Away from light and moisture, below 30 degrees Celsius, out of children's reach.

motion.title: Proton pumps, switched off
motion.lead: A gastric parietal cell: H⁺/K⁺ pumps send hydrogen ions into the stomach and make acid.

states.label: Acid secretion
states.caption: The proton pumps are active; hydrogen ions enter the stomach and acidity rises.

states.label: Esomeprazole
states.caption: The enteric coating protects the granule from stomach acid; esomeprazole is released, absorbed and reaches the pumps.

states.label: Less acid
states.caption: Blocked pumps stop sending ions; less acid is made and less of it flows back into the oesophagus.

name: Capsulizer
subtitle: Dry powder inhaler device (DPI)
summary: Ergonomic design and easy to carry; delivers medication evenly deep into the lungs. Especially suitable for the elderly and COPD patients.

sections.title: Easy, reliable and precise
sections.body: With its ergonomic design and easy portability, Capsulizer offers a new experience in using inhalation capsules. By delivering medication evenly deep into the lungs, it ensures greater effectiveness of the medicine.

sections.title: Why Capsulizer?
items: Easy portability: light and compact structure
Confidence in medication delivery: transparent, visible design
No cleaning hassle
Even delivery of medication deep into the lungs
Robust and durable
Suitable for everyone, including the elderly
Verified and reliable with international certifications

sections.title: A unique combination for better breathing
sections.body: Using Capsulizer together with Tiotoriva brings maximum effectiveness and comfort in the treatment of COPD.

motion.title: Inside the Capsulizer
motion.lead: The path of air through the device, from the air inlet to the mouthpiece.

states.label: Pierce
states.caption: Pressing the buttons drives the pins through both ends of the capsule.

states.label: Inhale
states.caption: Inhaled air enters the chamber and sets the capsule spinning and vibrating.

states.label: Fine powder
states.caption: Powder leaves through the holes, is broken up in the swirling air and exits through the mouthpiece.
